role: The End's WorldProvider: one sky biome, no sky light, dimension 1, celestial angle fixed at 0, a dim purple fog, ChunkProviderEnd as the generator, the hard-coded arrival point (100, 50, 0), average ground level 50, and no respawning.
scope_reason: The End is vanilla and in scope (SPEC Decisions: the Nether and the End are vanilla; the End and the dragon are in the loop).

members.name: registerWorldChunkManager
members.note: WorldChunkManagerHell(sky, 0.0F), dimensionId 1, hasNoSky: world dim 1, no_sky 1.

members.name: calcSunriseSunsetColors
members.note: Returns null in the End; the End sky (draw_end_sky) never asks, EntityRenderer.updateFogColor does when the look faces the sun's side. Not checked that rs_sunrise itself returns 0 for dim 1. cr-sweep-gold-g30-s42's End frame runs it (a frame replay: lane/covframes' coverage of the frame recordings)

members.name: getFogColor
members.note: 0xA080A0 times the constant 0.15; drawn in idx-dragondeath-s42's and cr-sweep-gold-g30-s42's End frames (a frame replay: lane/covframes' coverage of the frame recordings)

members.name: isSkyColored
members.note: its only caller is RenderGlobal.renderSky's isSurfaceWorld() branch; the End (dimension 1) takes renderSky's own End branch first, so it is never asked

members.name: isSurfaceWorld
members.note: No explicit counterpart; only client clock/compass rendering reads it.

members.name: getCloudHeight
members.note: 8.0; the End draws no clouds, so it is never read on the frame path.

members.name: canCoordinateBeSpawn
members.note: only WorldServer.createSpawnPosition calls it, in the branch after !provider.canRespawnHere(), and this provider's canRespawnHere is false

members.name: getEntrancePortalLocation
members.note: (100, 50, 0) is used where the player is placed on entering the End (ServerConfigurationManager.transferEntityToWorld); I did not find the literal cited next to this Java name.

members.name: doesXZShowFog
members.note: the xzfog input; drawn in idx-dragondeath-s42's End frames (a frame replay: lane/covframes' coverage of the frame recordings)

notes: Status exact because every server-side and frame behavior has a counterpart proven by the end-* recordings and dims dumps; the member-level partial entries are client presentation switches expressed as dimension checks. Recordings not rerun by me.
